checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: First ~5s show close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup
must.why: All four frames show a coffee stream pouring from a pot into a white ceramic cup, and the liquid level rises.
Only frames from the 0-5 s pour clip were provided.

must.item: End card reads exactly the URL with correct case and punctuation
must.why: The end card was not among the images. The assistant says it was drawn by code.

must.item: URL centered, white, one line, fully inside frame
must.why: The end card was not visible.
The pour frames show no text, captions or logos.
The frames are 480x854, which is 9:16. Audio and total length cannot be checked from stills, and the assistant reports 8.1 s and silent.

exact_text.read_as: The end card was not provided, so the URL could not be read. The pour frames contain no text.

faults.what: The end card could not be verified because only the pour clip frames were supplied.
A hand is partly visible at the top-left edge in the early frames. This is unrequested, but harmless.

summary: The pour shot is a clean, realistic close-up of coffee pouring into a white cup with no text. The black URL end card could not be checked from the supplied frames.
